events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary actor and comedian John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Royalty
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel chaos, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. An absolute sprawling masterpiece. What's your top track from it?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991 at the age of 45. He would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Forever Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. His voice, his presence, his legacy – truly unmatched. We miss you, legend.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' by The Beatles was released on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their musical evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Impact
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped. A masterpiece that pushed boundaries and still sounds incredible today. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic death of music icon John Lennon in 1980. He would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80 today
events.blurb: The legendary David Bowie, who passed away in 2016, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie Forever
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman on what would have been his 80th birthday. David Bowie, forever changing the landscape of music and art.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92 today
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. The King lives on!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock icon Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, his riffs are simply iconic. What's your favourite?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The unmistakable voice of Sir Rod Stewart, known for hits like 'Maggie May' and 'Da Ya Think I'm Sexy?', celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Happy 82nd Birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! Still rocking, still soulful. What's your go-to Rod track?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham 'Suggs' McPherson, the iconic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: One Step Beyond
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to Suggs from Madness! Here's to the Nutty Boy himself and all the fantastic tunes he's given us.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British blue-eyed soul singer Paul Young, famous for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Soulful Sounds
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 71st Birthday to Paul Young! Still loving his timeless voice. What's your favourite track to hear on the radio?

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81 today
events.blurb: The beloved country music legend Dolly Parton, who passed away in August 2026, would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Dolly Parton on what would have been her 81st birthday. Her music and spirit shine on forever.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: A Million Love Songs
angles.copy: Happy 56th Birthday to the brilliant Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to solo hits, what's your favourite song he's penned?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the smooth-voiced Billy Ocean! Still 'Suddenly' feeling good when his hits come on the radio.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame held first induction ceremony 41 years ago
events.blurb: The very first Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame induction ceremony took place on this day in 1986, honouring pioneers like Chuck Berry and Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Rock History Made
angles.copy: 41 years ago, rock history was officially cemented with the first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who's your all-time favourite inductee?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, known for his solo work and contributions to the iconic boy band, celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Still Shining
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday to Mark Owen! From Take That's early days to his recent solo albums, he's still got that magic touch.

events.title: The Beatles' famous rooftop concert was 58 years ago
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public concert on the rooftop of their Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Rockers
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles took to the rooftop for that iconic concert! Imagine being there. Pure magic.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Award-winning singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins, known for his solo career and work with Genesis, celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight
angles.copy: Happy 76th Birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! What's the Genesis or solo track that always gets you?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake, known for his solo hits and *NSYNC days, celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 46th Birthday to Justin Timberlake! From boyband heartthrob to solo sensation, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for his roles as Del Boy and Inspector Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! What's your favourite character he's brought to life?

events.title: 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died'
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died', when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash in 1959.

angles.name: Remembering Legends
angles.copy: 68 years ago today, we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. Their music lives on, forever young.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Pop icon Rick Astley, known for his global hit 'Never Gonna Give You Up', celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday to the one and only Rick Astley! Here's to more timeless tunes and perhaps a little 'Rickrolling' fun.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82 today
events.blurb: The legendary reggae pioneer Bob Marley, who passed away in 1981, would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love
angles.copy: Remembering Bob Marley on what would have been his 82nd birthday. His message of peace, love, and unity resonates stronger than ever.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Acclaimed singer-songwriter Carole King, a true legend of popular music, celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Tapestry of Talent
angles.copy: Happy 85th Birthday to the phenomenal Carole King! Her songs are the soundtrack to so many lives. What's your favourite?

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston, who would have been 64
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of 'The Voice', Whitney Houston, who died in 2012. She would have been 64 this year.

angles.name: Always Love You
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Whitney Houston today. Her voice was pure magic and continues to move us all.
